description: Ring modulator from Surge: a modelled diode ring driven by a unison carrier oscillator, with a high and low cut on the result.

params.text: Picks the carrier waveform, one of twenty-four shapes.
Sets the pitch of the carrier, as a MIDI note from 0 to 127.
Sets how far the carrier's unison voices are detuned from each other, 0 to 100 cents.
Sets how many carrier voices run at once, 1 to 16.
Sets the forward bias of the modelled diode ring, 0 to 100%.
Sets how wide the linear region of the modelled diode ring is, 0 to 100%.
Sets the corner of a high-pass filter on the ring-modulated signal, 13.75Hz to 25kHz.
Sets the corner of a low-pass filter on the ring-modulated signal, 13.75Hz to 25kHz.
Sets how much ring-modulated signal is mixed with the dry input, 0 to 100%.
Nothing in the module reads this knob; the ring modulator has nine parameters and the panel carries twelve knobs.
Scales both inputs before the effect processes them, from silence to unity gain.
Scales both outputs after the effect, from silence to unity gain.

inputs.text: The left input into the effect; with the right input unpatched this one feeds both channels.
The right input into the effect.
Adds to the Shape knob, a tenth of its full range per volt.
Adds to the Pitch knob, a tenth of its full range per volt.
Adds to the Unison Detune knob, a tenth of its full range per volt.
Adds to the Unison Voices knob, a tenth of its full range per volt.
Adds to the Forward Bias knob, a tenth of its full range per volt.
Adds to the Linear Region knob, a tenth of its full range per volt.
Adds to the Low Cut knob, a tenth of its full range per volt.
Adds to the High Cut knob, a tenth of its full range per volt.
Adds to the Mix knob, a tenth of its full range per volt.
Nothing in the module reads this jack; the ring modulator has nine parameters and the panel carries twelve CV jacks.
Nothing in the module reads this jack; no parameter of the ring modulator can be tempo-synced.

outputs.text: The left output of the effect; with the right output unpatched this one carries an even mix of the two channels.
The right output of the effect.

notes: the effect runs in blocks of 32 samples, so it delays the signal by 32 samples and reads its CV inputs once per block.
this module is deprecated and hidden in the module browser; the Surge XT plugin replaces it, and both plugins can be used in one patch.
menu: Skins — a submenu of four colour schemes, listed by file name as Classic.xml, Miami.xml, NewYork.xml and Night.xml; picking one repaints every Surge module in the rack.
